item.title: Version 1.10.0
item.description:
Ask your AI assistant

StockDock is now an MCP server: Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients can read your portfolios and watchlist and get live quotes.

  • Your portfolio, in plain words. Ask “How is my portfolio doing today?” and get value, P&L and today's change per holding and in total, in your currency.
  • Any ticker. Live quotes for stocks, ETFs, crypto and forex, even outside your watchlist.
  • Read-only. Nothing is saved or changed. Set it up in one line: see “Use it with Claude” in the README.
